newsitem.title: UK: Laura Ashley says 17-week sales flat.
newsitem.headline: Laura Ashley says 17-week sales flat.

text.p: British retailer Laura Ashley Holdings Plc said on Friday sales in the first 17 weeks of the current business year were flat compared with the year-earlier period when adjusted for currency fluctuations.
In April the company said sales for the first eleven weeks were up two percent on a like-for-like basis when adjusted for currency.
"Since then the rate of total sales increase has declined marginally. On a like-for-like basis, sales for the first seventeen weeks were flat," the retailer said.
